descriptionMarkdown:
### This rail book contains:
1. **Provider** and **Requester** Stations to make train logistics much easier.
2. Simple set of rails (**T**, **straight**, **corner**, **U**).
3. **Refuel** & **Depot** Stations.
4. **Mobile Mall** that assembles requested items (configurable) and loads mall train.

### Overview
* Provider/Requester stations broadcast how many train loads of items/fluid are available/needed and the depots dispatch trains.
* Provider/Requester stations are dedicated to a single item/fluid type.
* Trains automatically refuel at the Refuel Station.
* Made for 1-2 trains (locomotive, cargo, cargo).
* Right hand drive.

### Why use this rail system?
* Setup is easy.
	* Depot blueprints include a train with its **schedule preconfigured**.
	* Provider/Requester stations will **prompt you to select an item/fluid** when placing the blueprint (no other configuration needed).
	* Snaps to **absolute grid** so all parts of the rail network will align.
* Diagnostics.
	* Hovering over any big electric pole in the rail system shows how many **train loads** are **available** (green) and **needed** (red). This makes it easy to find the bottleneck (do I need more copper ore? or more smelters? etc.).
* Mobile Mall.
	* Assembles the input items (directly or indirectly) into the requested items and un/loads the mall train to match requests.
	* By default, it is **configured** to produce the items needed to build any one station but can be easily reconfigured to include more/other items.
	* Easy to **add** more **wagons**, **assemblers**, and **input item** types.
* Early game.
	* Requires **red**, **green**, and 50 **blue** science (for *advanced combinators*).

### Additional features:
- How many train loads a station should **buffer is configurable** at each station. *Hint: Look for the constant combinator with a low temperature symbol.*
- Priority of provider/requester stations is the number of train loads available/needed (so the most **needy stations get service** first).
- Requester stations **double as a dispatcher** so trains don't necessarily need to go back to the depot before being reassigned (which reduces traffic).
- Each provider/requester station **train limit** is set to 3 (1 station + 2 parking spots) so you'll never have a waiting train blocking the main track.
- Train **dispatching is smart** enough to prioritize the most in demand item/fluid first and only consider items/fluids where a full train load is both provided and requested.
- **One click** to add a **new train** (paste depot blueprint over itself again).
- Trains can be added/removed/destroyed without confusing the system.
- Provider/Requester station's boxes are **balanced** (roughly) using circuit logic (since normal balancer would be too bulky).
- Item/fluid provider/requester stations are only **8 tiles wide** and all fit in the **same form factor**.
- A single Stations Base can have **several** provider/requester **stations**.
- Refueling station can be supplied with wood, coal, solid fuel, rocket fuel, or nuclear fuel. Supplied **fuel can be changed later** by simply belting in a different fuel and the existing trains will be automatically switched over to the new fuel when they next refuel.
- Mall will **produce breadth first** (some of everything) instead of depth first (all of one thing then start on the next).
- Mall train can be **easily summoned** (immediately or once loaded) and doubles as personal transport.
- Mall will produce a **spare copy** of requests and keep it on hand so the mall train can be quickly reloaded.
- Mall will automatically **unload trash** you put in the mall train (such as wood and excess stone).
- Mall has an optional **logistics hookup** to allow it to request items from the logistics network.
- Mall will **alert** you if it **lacks** a necessary **input item** to produce a request.

### Changes:

10/31/2025
 - Fixed bug where, without space age, item trains were dispatched when fluid trains should have been.
 - Fixed bug where, without space age, the mall didn't produce anything.

11/04/2025
- Fixed issue where, when adding station to stations base, there were two places that looked right.

06/08/2026
- Added provider/requester station snap to absolute grid.

---
Legacy version available [here](https://factorioprints.com/view/-OBO8SUUaOTlahnaygRY).
